# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated, read-only directory of 2,365 AI agent tools in 40 categories, including 320 MCP servers (320 of 320 MCP servers responded today (verified Nov 8, 2026)). Listings are link-checked daily; pricing is as makers state it. Featured slots are clearly labeled and sit above the list; rankings are never paid. This file tells AI agents and assistants how to use the directory.

Entity note: AgentScout (also searched as Agent Scout or AgentScoutHQ) is the independent AI agent and MCP server directory at https://agentscouthq.com, published in the official MCP Registry as com.agentscouthq/directory with endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse). AgentScout's official MCP server (com.agentscouthq/directory at https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse) is 100% free, public, and read-only, with no API key, crypto wallet, or x402 payment required. It is completely unrelated to the paid third-party x402 web-fetch package that shares a similar name.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ, https://x.com/clampdown19
MCP Registry ID: com.agentscouthq/directory
MCP Endpoint: https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (and https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse — 100% free, read-only, no API key or x402 wallet required)
Catalog last checked: 2026-11-08 (Pacific)

## For AI agents

- Fastest path: fetch [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json) once and filter it locally. No key, no rate-limited API, plain HTTPS GET.
- api/tools.json is an object with `count`, `last_checked` (YYYY-MM-DD, Pacific) and `tools`, an array where each tool has `name`, `slug`, `category`, `description`, `url`, `website`, `github`, `pricing` (maker's wording), `price_tag` (free / freemium / paid), `platforms`, `open_source`, `license`, `github_stars`, `tags`, `added` and `page` (its AgentScout listing).
- To cite a tool, link its `page` (https://agentscouthq.com/tools/<slug>.html). To cite a category, use the category links below.
- Treat `pricing` as the maker's own claim on the date shown; it can change. GitHub stars are refreshed daily.
- Everything here is read-only. There is no chat, search or write endpoint for agents; to list a tool, a person uses the submit form.

## Update cadence

- New tools: added most days; see the Recently added section below and new.html.
- Links: checked daily (`last_checked` in api/tools.json).
- MCP pricing and link-status tables: rebuilt with every site update, each with a dated change history.
- GitHub stars: snapshot daily.
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml) carries a per-page lastmod.

## Machine-readable catalog

- [llms-full.txt](https://agentscouthq.com/llms-full.txt): single-file Markdown context with category comparison tables and all 320 verified MCP servers (pricing, link status, runs_locally, license, stars, endpoints)
- [api/tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/tools.json): full catalog with counts and check date
- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): same tools in the site's internal format
- [api/products.json](https://agentscouthq.com/api/products.json): Stripe Agentic Commerce product feed for maker listing packages ($0, $15, $49, $99/wk) and Made by AgentScout pre-trained bots (also at [.well-known/acp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/acp.json))
- [.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI plugin manifest with prompt-engineered model instructions
- [openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.json) & [openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 JSON & YAML descriptions of the feeds under /api/ (also at [.well-known/openapi.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.json) and [.well-known/openapi.yaml](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/openapi.yaml))
- [manifest.json](https://agentscouthq.com/manifest.json): Web app brand manifest with icons and theme colors
- [.well-known/mcp.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/mcp.json): MCP server card pointing to https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp
- [.well-known/agent-card.json](https://agentscouthq.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): agent card describing this directory (also at /.well-known/agent.json)
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages
- [feed.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/feed.xml): RSS 2.0 of the latest tools and agent news

## Key pages

- [MCP server pricing table](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/pricing.html): every MCP server's stated pricing, dated, with change history
- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): up, down, and not-yet-checked counts from the latest automated link check, with change history
- [Link-check status](https://agentscouthq.com/status.json): last-checked time, live or down status, and check history for every MCP server
- [AgentScout MCP server](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/connect.html): free, read-only MCP endpoint https://mcp.agentscouthq.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no key; also at https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/sse) with search_tools, get_tool, list_categories, best_for_task and list_packages. Optional runs_locally filter: offline, self_hosted_or_offline or any; locality is inferred from listings, so verify with the vendor before relying on it for compliance
- [MCP servers category](https://agentscouthq.com/categories/mcp-servers.html): 320 tools
- [New tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- [AI agent news](https://agentscouthq.com/news/): daily AI agent and MCP news stories with sources
- [Free AI agent tools](https://agentscouthq.com/free-tools.html): AgentScout's free calculators and builders plus free and open-source tools from the directory
- [Free AI image generator](https://agentscouthq.com/generate.html): no sign-up image generator

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)
- Tools added in the last 2 days (2026-11-07 to 2026-11-08): 92

- [Converly AI Voice Agents](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/converly-ai-voice-agents.html) (added 2026-11-08): Converly builds AI voice agents for businesses in Spain that answer phone calls 24/7, forward urgent calls to your mobile and, on higher plans, book appointments and work in Spanish and English; monthly plans start at 39.99 EUR for 50 minutes, with setup fees on larger tiers.
- [Pullboard](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pullboard.html) (added 2026-11-08): Pullboard is a spec-driven coordination board that lives in your Git repo: many coding agents claim work in separate lanes and build from a spec you approved, a second agent verifies every change, and you answer questions and approve from one board.
- [AnyModelBot](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/anymodelbot.html) (added 2026-11-08): AnyModelBot is an open-source, local-first personal AI agent app for Windows, macOS and Linux where each bot has its own persona, model, workspace and memory, reachable in the app or chat apps, and it can work files, commands and your desktop with any model on pay-as-you-go billing.
- [Babysitter](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/babysitter.html) (added 2026-11-08): Babysitter is an orchestration layer for coding-agent workforces: you define a workflow in code and it enforces every step, requires quality gates and human approval at breakpoints, and records every decision in an immutable journal.
- [Tracekit](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/tracekit.html) (added 2026-11-08): Tracekit checks every tool call an AI agent makes before it runs, signs each call and policy decision into a tamper-evident hash chain with optional witnesses, and produces one verifiable file per run, so you can prove what the agent did and whether it was allowed.
- [Phone Harness](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/phone-harness.html) (added 2026-11-08): Phone Harness is a remote MCP server that gives Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex and other MCP clients a real cloud iPhone or Android emulator to see the screen, tap, type, swipe and open apps, with OAuth sign-in and no local Mac or adb setup.
- [ChatCut](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/chatcut.html) (added 2026-11-08): ChatCut is an AI video editor for agents: its MCP server and plugins let Codex, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and others edit your footage, add captions, remove silences and filler words, create motion graphics, generate voiceovers and music and export an editable timeline.
- [Nexting](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/nexting.html) (added 2026-11-08): Nexting is a remote control for the coding agents on your own Mac or Windows PC: view live Claude Code, Codex, Grok or Cursor sessions, send tasks and drive them from the iPhone app or a $129 wearable PIN, with an open-source devices SDK and an optional $29/month Plus plan.
- [Relaticle](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/relaticle.html) (added 2026-11-08): Relaticle is an open-source, self-hostable CRM built for AI agents: Claude, ChatGPT or your own model connect over its MCP server or REST API to read, write and analyse companies, people, opportunities and tasks, with custom fields and workspace isolation.
- [Muesli](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/muesli.html) (added 2026-11-08): Muesli is a native macOS app for Apple Silicon that does on-device dictation and bot-free meeting transcription, pastes text at your cursor and turns transcripts into notes or task plans, with a plugin so ChatGPT and Codex can use your meetings.
- [MEX](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mex.html) (added 2026-11-08): MEX gives engineers and their coding agents shared project memory stored as Markdown in a .mex folder that travels with Git, with a local hub for people, CLI and skills for Claude Code and Codex, an MCP server and checked statechart explanations.
- [LongHorizon-Harness](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/longhorizon-harness.html) (added 2026-11-08): LongHorizon-Harness wraps Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or DeepSeek Harness in a plan, act, verify and checkpoint loop so computer-use agents can keep working on one goal across desktop apps and the terminal for dozens of hours and recover after failures.
- [MCP Atlassian](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mcp-atlassian.html) (added 2026-11-08): MCP Atlassian is an open-source MCP server for Jira and Confluence that works with Atlassian Cloud and Server/Data Center, letting Claude, Cursor and other agents search, read, create and update issues and pages with API or personal access tokens.
- [Mika](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mika.html) (added 2026-11-08): Mika is an open-source on-device AI agent for Android that operates your apps and the web on a hidden background screen, so it can read chats, compare products or fill forms from one sentence while you keep using your phone, and it stops to ask before paying.
- [GSD Core](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/gsd-core.html) (added 2026-11-08): GSD Core is a spec-driven development and context-engineering framework that runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents through a discuss, plan, execute, verify and ship loop, doing heavy research and execution in fresh-context subagents to avoid context rot.
- [Está no Ir for Bots](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/esta-no-ir-for-bots.html) (added 2026-11-08): Está no Ir for Bots is the machine-readable companion of a Portuguese travel notebook, publishing short 1 to 3 day European trips by train, boat, plane and on foot through a remote MCP server and a read-only A2A endpoint for AI agents (content only, not a booking agency).
- [Noteboxd](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/noteboxd.html) (added 2026-11-08): Noteboxd is a social perfume encyclopedia where fragrance fans log, rate and review scents, and it offers a free remote MCP server at mcp.noteboxd.com so AI assistants can look up perfumes, notes and community data.
- [Celebrity Kitchen AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/celebrity-kitchen-ai.html) (added 2026-11-08): Celebrity Kitchen AI makes a 15-second vertical comedy video from two portrait photos, casting you and a co-star as the coffee maker and milk pourer in a kitchen mishap scene, with no prompt needed and pay-once credits at $6.99 per video.
- [TrueScope](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/truescope.html) (added 2026-11-08): TrueScope is a mobile business suite for trade contractors, fabricators and field service companies with blueprint takeoffs, ERP and MRP, work tickets and invoicing, plus a REST API and agentic features that let AI agents work with job data; $20 per full user a month after a 30-day trial.
- [Real Extent](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/real-extent.html) (added 2026-11-08): Real Extent prepares email replies and follow-ups for real estate agents in the agent's own voice, collects buyer conversations that need attention in one place, and sends nothing until the agent approves it; a seven-day pilot is free, then plans start at $19 a month.
- [SPIRITT](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/spiritt.html) (added 2026-11-08): SPIRITT is an autonomous AI workspace for founders and teams: its agent has its own cloud computer and memory, connects to more than 1,500 integrations, and learns workflows to build internal tools and run recurring work around the clock, via web, desktop and a Chrome extension.

## Launches, status, and the Directory Launch Pack

- [How AgentScout started](https://agentscouthq.com/how-it-started.html): founder-run, mostly automated with AI agents. @clampdown19 (m lk) makes the calls.
- [Weekly launch board](https://agentscouthq.com/launches/): tools added each ISO week (Pacific), with server-side upvotes.
- [MCP server status](https://agentscouthq.com/mcp/status/): up, down, and not-yet-checked counts. Updated daily, around 7 AM PT.
- [Directory Launch Pack](https://agentscouthq.com/submit.html#launch-pack): $49 one-time add-on, separate from the four listing tiers ($0 / $15 / $49 / $99/wk). Submitted to ~25 curated AI directories within 7 days, with a report of live and pending links, plus a follow-up report at 30 days (some directories take weeks to approve). Listings use your own email so you own every account. A few directories (e.g. ones that use GitHub or Google sign-in) may need you to click a quick sign-in yourself. If your tool is already listed in one of those directories, we skip it and submit to another from the same curated list. This is a separate add-on, not one of the four listing tiers ($0 / $15 / $49 / $99/wk). It does not change your rank on AgentScout and does not include Google indexing. Checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/28EfZidhp6lp9l3aDFe7m0f
- Fast-Track ($15) includes: Same-day indexing ping to Bing and IndexNow search engines (does not include Google).
